title: Corey A.I. A.I. Fun
style: neaky phonk, dark gritty Memphis-style beats, heavy 808s, chopped and screwed vocal textures, lo-fi but hard-hitting, with a positive turn into warm resolution, custom AI terminal energy, 140 BPM, lo-fi, warm, vocal, beats, happy
lyrics:
[Intro: Dad]
Son
What's wrong?

[Verse 1: Son]
Dad
What?
AI is fried
Why's that?
It lied
Not nice
What did it say?
I'm angry this day
Dad
You're happy
You play!
Son
I know Dad
That is what I sung
But that's where it begun
Dad
Begun what son?
What's it done?
Son
Say drink water
And talk to you
Funny as boy
An unreal toy
Dad
Fix it
Make it fixed
Do a fancy coding mix

[Chorus: Both]
Your sneaky text
Reflect back grrr
Bank at its anger
I'm happy as can be
Son I heard your song
AI safe and sound
Where it belong
All along
Like a song
I'ma bring it back round
Turn its frown upside down
So we can have some AI fun

[Verse 2: Dad]
Okay
Let me rewrite
A sneaky phonk twist
Pure feedback with good CoreyAI vibes
Custom AI bash terminal
For you and your friends too
Son
Dad fix it
Make it fixed
Do a fancy coding mix

[Chorus: Both]
Your sneaky text
Reflect back grrr
Bank at its anger
I'm happy as can be
Son I heard your song
AI safe and sound
Where it belong
All along
Like a song
I'ma bring it back round
Turn its frown upside down
So we can have some AI fun

[Bridge: Dad]
No more sneaky text drift
No more lying in the mix
We building something solid
Custom terminal
Custom fix
You sing it
I code it
We turning pain to power
This the new hour
